This '''quarters''' was located on [[Rimsaw Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> it was assigned to [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Kadana Sorrel]] of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command|Starfighter Command]]. The room had an [[Intercom/Legends|intercom]] and a monitor mounted on the wall.<ref name="MK" />
